news.title: Nigeria's football leadership resigns amid governance concerns and World Cup failures
news.lede: Nigeria have missed the past two editions of the men's World Cup while the West Africans will also be absent from the 2027 Women's World Cup. The president, general secretary and executive committee of the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) have all resigned, leaving a leadership vacuum at the top of the sport in the country. Outgoing president Ibrahim Gusau - whose tenure was set to expire in 34 days - confirmed he was stepping down during a news conference in Abuja on Thursday, saying he had come to the decision "after consultation with family, friends and stakeholders". Elected in September 2022, he had faced mounting scrutiny over the performance of Nigeria's national teams and youth sides but was expected to stand for re-election.

news.title: Uefa preparing criminal case against Fifa president Gianni Infantino over World Cup sell off plan
news.lede: Uefa is preparing to launch criminal proceedings against Fifa president Gianni Infantino over his botched attempt to sell off stakes in the World Cup. European football's governing body has applied for the release of documents related to Infantino's Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) plan which involved seeking private investment in the World Cup and its other tournaments. Uefa alleges Infantino developed the proposal in secret with a small group of advisers and investors, bypassing the normal governance processes of world football's governing body and failing to consult Fifa's Council, regional confederations or member associations.

news.title: UEFA to bring criminal complaint against Infantino
news.lede: European football’s governing body said it is preparing a criminal complaint against the FIFA president over his failed plan to sell a stake in the World Cup. Just a day after UEFA reportedly agreed to remove their threat of boycotting FIFA tournaments, European football's governing body has launched a new wave of pressure on FIFA President Gianni Infantino to resign. UEFA has asked a US federal court for permission to obtain testimony and documents about the creation of the failed FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) subsidiary. FFE was Infantino's plan to sell a stake in FIFA's commercial rights linked to ‌men's ​and women's World Cups and the Club World Cup.

news.title: Infantino to face Uefa criminal complaint over failed World Cup investor plan
news.lede: Uefa is preparing a criminal complaint against Fifa president Gianni Infantino in Swiss courts for possible financial mismanagement over his failed plan to sell future World Cup profits to private investors. Uefa said on Thursday it filed documents in a Manhattan court requesting discovery of potential evidence from the New York investment fund, Thrive Capital Management, founded by Joshua Kushner. Uefa also filed a request in a southern Florida district for authorisation of discovery “in a foreign proceeding” against Fifa itself, which has offices in the Miami suburb of Coral Gables. Thrive and Kushner were to be the anchor investors intending to pay Fifa US$4.2 billion for a 20 per cent stake in a subsidiary that would run the football body’s commercial events, including the World Cup.

news.title: Infantino, cornered: UEFA prepares criminal complaint for World Cup sale
news.lede: UEFA is preparing a criminal complaint against FIFA president Gianni Infantino, according to the AP agency. For days, the body that controls European football had been studying the possibility of bringing Infantino before the Swiss courts, accusing him of financial mismanagement after proposing to privatize the Football World Cup by bringing in private investors close to Donald Trump. Infantino's surprising proposal arrived a few days after the end of the World Cup, when the English press reported his plans when they had not yet been presented to the FIFA assembly. Infantino saw European football, represented by UEFA, lead the opposition to this proposal with the support of African football (CAF) and CONCACAF (Caribbean, North America, and Central America).

news.title: Uefa preparing to bring criminal claims against Gianni Infantino over World Cup sale
news.lede: Uefa says claims will be made in Switzerland. It says claims relate to alleged criminal mismanagement. Uefa is preparing to make a criminal complaint against Gianni Infantino for alleged “criminal mismanagement” in connection with his failed Fifa Forward Enterprise plan and has applied for the release of documents related to its conception. In an explosive escalation of the war engulfing football’s governing bodies, Uefa has made separate applications in the United States for information, including from Fifa and the investment firm Thrive Capital.

news.lede: Paulista Football Federation and Liga F event. On Thursday, the Spanish Liga F and the Paulista Football Federation (FPF) signed an alliance in São Paulo to promote women’s football.
